sourcedFrom: Uso • Manutenzione | Use • Maintenance — the “SuperNova Pump Action” shotgun (Benelli multilingual owner's manual) — G0282500 - 01/2011 (01/2011 (printed as the document code G0282500 - 01/2011; no separate © line))
cleanIntro: Benelli's own strip for the SuperNova Pump Action. Mechanically this is the Nova's action in a different shell — rotating locking head, action bars that hook the bolt, trigger group out on two pins — but the SuperNova adds one thing the Nova book does not have: if a pistol grip or telescopic stock is fitted, the stock has to be LOOSENED before the trigger guard will come out, and tightened again after it goes back. Skip that and you will be levering at a trigger group that physically cannot clear the receiver.

steps.title: Safety catch on — the red ring must disappear
steps.action: Press the crossbolt safety button on the trigger guard until the red ring is no longer visible.
steps.prose: Benelli defines the safe state by what you cannot see rather than by which way the button points. Red showing means it will fire, and you are about to work the action repeatedly.
steps.quote: Press the safety button on the trigger guard until its red ring, indicating firing position, is no longer visible (figs. 2A - 2B).
steps.cite: Uso • Manutenzione | Use • Maintenance — the “SuperNova Pump Action” shotgun (Benelli multilingual owner's manual) — G0282500 - 01/2011 — Gun safety catch — p.34

steps.title: Chambered round out by hand, muzzle safe, fingers off the trigger
steps.action: With the safety engaged and the muzzle pointed somewhere safe, depress the breech bolt latch and pull the fore-end slowly rearward until the cartridge is out of the chamber and lying on the carrier. Turn the gun toward the ejection port and take the cartridge out.
steps.prose: Slowly and partially is the whole instruction — run the fore-end back briskly and the round is flung out of the port instead of handed to you. The breech bolt latch has to be pressed first or a closed bolt will not open at all.
steps.quote: Engage the safety. Depress the breech bolt latch; slowly pull the fore-end rearward until the cartridge is extracted from the chamber and is resting inside the action on the carrier. Turn the firearm toward the ejection port side and remove the cartridge.
steps.cite: Uso • Manutenzione | Use • Maintenance — the “SuperNova Pump Action” shotgun (Benelli multilingual owner's manual) — G0282500 - 01/2011 — Unloading — manual unloading, step 1, p.56

steps.title: Empty the magazine tube, then check all three places
steps.action: Close the bolt on an empty chamber, then release the shells from the magazine one at a time. Finish by checking barrel, carrier and magazine are all completely empty.
steps.prose: An empty chamber on a pump gun means nothing while the tube is loaded — the first stroke of the fore-end in the strip below would chamber a live round. Benelli names three places to check, not one, and the carrier is the one people forget.
steps.quote: Check that the barrel, carrier, and magazine are completely empty.
steps.cite: Uso • Manutenzione | Use • Maintenance — the “SuperNova Pump Action” shotgun (Benelli multilingual owner's manual) — G0282500 - 01/2011 — Unloading — manual unloading, step 4, p.58

steps.title: Prove it empty once more before a single part moves
steps.action: Before starting any part of the strip, make sure the chamber, carrier and magazine are unloaded.
steps.prose: Benelli reprints this at the head of the stripping section rather than trusting the clearing section to have done its job, and it is the right instinct: the gun has been handled and turned over since you cleared it.
steps.quote: Before starting any operation on your shotgun, make sure that the chamber, carrier and the magazine are unloaded! (Carefully read the instructions on gun loading and unloading).
steps.cite: Uso • Manutenzione | Use • Maintenance — the “SuperNova Pump Action” shotgun (Benelli multilingual owner's manual) — G0282500 - 01/2011 — Shotgun stripping (for cleaning and maintenance) — p.70

steps.title: Bolt forward, barrel retaining cap off
steps.action: Move the bolt forward, then unscrew the barrel retaining cap from the end of the magazine tube.
steps.prose: The bolt goes forward first so the action is closed while you turn a cap against spring pressure. Keep the cap — Benelli built a peg into its front face and it is the tool for the trigger guard pins two steps from now.
steps.quote: Move the bolt forward and unscrew the barrel retaining cap (fig. 19).
steps.cite: Uso • Manutenzione | Use • Maintenance — the “SuperNova Pump Action” shotgun (Benelli multilingual owner's manual) — G0282500 - 01/2011 — Stripping procedure, step 1, p.70

steps.title: Barrel forward off the magazine tube
steps.action: Take hold of the barrel where it stands clear of the magazine tube and slide it straight forward off the gun.
steps.prose: Straight forward, holding it out from the tube. The barrel extension carries the recesses the rotating bolt head locks into, so these are pressure-bearing surfaces — do not lever the barrel sideways to start it moving.
steps.quote: Hold the barrel out from the magazine tube and slide it forward (fig. 20).
steps.cite: Uso • Manutenzione | Use • Maintenance — the “SuperNova Pump Action” shotgun (Benelli multilingual owner's manual) — G0282500 - 01/2011 — Stripping procedure, step 2, p.72

steps.title: Trigger guard pins out with the magazine cap, then the guard off
steps.action: Use the magazine cap to push the two trigger guard fixing pins out, then hook them with the same cap and draw them clear. Take the trigger guard off.
steps.prose: The punch is built into the cap, so there is no excuse for a screwdriver near those pins. Note the two pins are not the same length — which hole the long one belongs in is called out separately in the assembly section.
steps.quote: Using the magazine cap, push out the trigger guard fixing pins and still using the magazine cap - hook them and take them off of their places (figs. 21-22).
steps.cite: Uso • Manutenzione | Use • Maintenance — the “SuperNova Pump Action” shotgun (Benelli multilingual owner's manual) — G0282500 - 01/2011 — Stripping procedure, step 3, p.72

steps.title: STOP if a pistol grip or telescopic stock is fitted — loosen it first
steps.action: If your SuperNova wears a pistol grip stock or a telescopic stock, partially unscrew the pistol grip stock retaining nut or the telescopic grip retaining ring nut and detach the grip from the receiver. Only then will there be room to take the trigger guard assembly out.
steps.prose: This is the SuperNova's own instruction and it has no equivalent in the Nova book. The grip hardware physically occupies the space the trigger group has to move through, so on a tactical-stocked gun the previous step simply will not complete — and forcing it damages the receiver, not the stock. Remember it on the way back too: the manual is equally explicit that the stock must be TIGHTENED again after the trigger guard is back in, until the nut solidly contacts the receiver.
steps.quote: WARNING: when the pistol grip or telescopic stock is installed on the shotgun the stock must be loosened before the trigger guard assembly can be removed from the receiver.
steps.cite: Uso • Manutenzione | Use • Maintenance — the “SuperNova Pump Action” shotgun (Benelli multilingual owner's manual) — G0282500 - 01/2011 — Stripping procedure — warning at step 4, p.74
steps.warn: WARNING: when the pistol grip or telescopic stock is installed on the shotgun the stock must be tightened after the trigger guard assembly has been installed in the receiver. Completely tighten the pistol grip stock retaining nut or the telescopic stock grip retaining ring nut until it solidly contacts the shotgun receiver.

steps.title: Gun reversed, action bars lifted, slide pulled back to separate
steps.action: Turn the shotgun over, lift the action bars slightly, and at the same time pull the slide back to separate the two.
steps.prose: Both hands do different things at once, deliberately — the action bars hook onto the bolt guide and only release when lifted off it. Pulling straight back without the lift just drags the whole assembly along its track.
steps.quote: Reverse the shotgun, lift the action bars slightly, and pull back the slide at the same time to separate the action bars (fig. 24).
steps.cite: Uso • Manutenzione | Use • Maintenance — the “SuperNova Pump Action” shotgun (Benelli multilingual owner's manual) — G0282500 - 01/2011 — Stripping procedure, step 5, p.76

steps.title: Bolt unit off the receiver by compressing its head
steps.action: Hold the bolt unit, push the top of it, and take the unit off the receiver.
steps.prose: That push compresses the rotating locking head back into the bolt body. The SuperNova locks like a semi-auto — lugs on a turning head into the barrel extension — and until the head is pushed in, the unit will not clear its channel.
steps.quote: Hold the bolt unit and, pushing the top, take it off of the receiver (figs. 25-26).
steps.cite: Uso • Manutenzione | Use • Maintenance — the “SuperNova Pump Action” shotgun (Benelli multilingual owner's manual) — G0282500 - 01/2011 — Stripping procedure, step 6, p.76

steps.title: Fore-end forward and off, unhooking the action bars
steps.action: Slide the fore-end forward slowly, unhooking the action bars from the receiver.
steps.prose: Slowly, because the bars are still running in their tracks for the first part of the travel and will bind if the fore-end is twisted on its way out.
steps.quote: Slide the fore-end forward slowly, unhooking the action bars from the receiver (fig. 27).
steps.cite: Uso • Manutenzione | Use • Maintenance — the “SuperNova Pump Action” shotgun (Benelli multilingual owner's manual) — G0282500 - 01/2011 — Stripping procedure, step 7, p.76

steps.title: Firing pin out — only when it needs it
steps.action: If the firing pin needs cleaning, remove its retaining pin while holding the firing pin and its return spring, then draw the firing pin out complete with its spring.
steps.prose: Benelli says "when necessary" rather than "always". The maintenance section explains when it becomes necessary: powder residue reaches the firing pin the same way it reaches the trigger group. Hold it as the retaining pin comes out — there is a spring behind it.
steps.quote: When necessary, proceed with the disassembly of the firing pin, removing the retaining pin (fig. 28); hold the firing pin and its return spring.
steps.cite: Uso • Manutenzione | Use • Maintenance — the “SuperNova Pump Action” shotgun (Benelli multilingual owner's manual) — G0282500 - 01/2011 — Stripping procedure, step 8, p.78

steps.title: Strip complete — Benelli says so in as many words
steps.action: You have the barrel, the magazine cap, the trigger guard with its two pins, the bolt unit, the fore-end with its action bars, the stock-receiver, and the firing pin with its spring.
steps.prose: There is no deeper published procedure in this book. The trigger group comes out and goes back as a unit and is not taken apart at this level, and the rotating head stays in the bolt.
steps.quote: The shotgun is now completely stripped. All the parts that require routine maintenance and cleaning are disassembled.
steps.cite: Uso • Manutenzione | Use • Maintenance — the “SuperNova Pump Action” shotgun (Benelli multilingual owner's manual) — G0282500 - 01/2011 — Stripping procedure, after step 9, p.80

steps.title: Barrel first, and leave the choke tube in it
steps.action: Clean the bore normally after use. Do NOT unscrew the internal choke tube to do it. Use Benelli's own cleaning set and oil, which is not supplied with the shotgun.
steps.prose: That note reverses what most people assume. Taking the choke out to clean behind it is precisely how residue gets into the choke threads inside the barrel, and those threads are far worse to clean than the bore ever is.
steps.quote: NOTE: whilst cleaning the gun the internal choke tubes are not to be stripped out. This in order to avoid residues collecting in the barrel’s internal choke tube’s connection threads.
steps.cite: Uso • Manutenzione | Use • Maintenance — the “SuperNova Pump Action” shotgun (Benelli multilingual owner's manual) — G0282500 - 01/2011 — Maintenance — note, p.68

steps.title: Bolt unit and trigger group: periodic cleaning of powder residue
steps.action: Take the bolt assembly down, clean and lubricate it on a schedule. Do the same for the firing mechanism — hammer, trigger and the rest of the group.
steps.prose: Benelli's position is that these guns need no special maintenance, only that the two places powder residue collects get attention on a schedule rather than on a hunch. The manual's own text here is the shared Benelli boilerplate and says "Automatic Shotguns" even in this pump gun's book; the items it lists are the ones this gun has.
steps.quote: 3) the bolt assembly may also become clogged with the same residuals over mentioned and therefore must be periodically dismantled, cleaned and lubricated;
steps.cite: Uso • Manutenzione | Use • Maintenance — the “SuperNova Pump Action” shotgun (Benelli multilingual owner's manual) — G0282500 - 01/2011 — Maintenance, item 3, p.66

steps.title: Oil what the weather can reach
steps.action: Lightly oil the parts exposed to the atmosphere to keep the gun in good order.
steps.prose: This is the anti-corrosion pass, not the lubrication pass — a wiped film on external steel. Flooding the trigger group in the name of protection is how a pump gun ends up with a paste of oil and powder in exactly the place the previous step told you to keep clean.
steps.quote: 4) to keep the gun in good order, oiling of the parts subject to atmospheric corrosion is recommended.
steps.cite: Uso • Manutenzione | Use • Maintenance — the “SuperNova Pump Action” shotgun (Benelli multilingual owner's manual) — G0282500 - 01/2011 — Maintenance, item 4, p.68

deepAbsentReason: This book publishes ONE teardown, headed "Shotgun stripping (for cleaning and maintenance)", and closes it with "The shotgun is now completely stripped". It already reaches the firing pin and its spring. There is no further published user-level disassembly for the SuperNova to promote into a deep clean; the trigger group is removed and refitted as a unit throughout.

cleaning.name: Barrel
tasks: Normal cleaning of the bore after use.
Leave the internal choke tube installed while cleaning — removing it lets residue into the choke threads inside the barrel.
Benelli Armi cleaning set and oil only (not supplied with the shotgun).

cleaning.name: Trigger group
tasks: Hammer, trigger and the rest of the firing mechanism cleaned of powder residue and foreign matter.
Periodic cleaning or lubrication — the group comes out and goes back as a unit.

cleaning.name: Bolt unit
tasks: Dismantled, cleaned and lubricated periodically — it clogs with the same residue as the trigger group.
Rotating locking head and its channel in the bolt body.
Firing pin and its return spring, when residue has reached them.

cleaning.name: External surfaces
tasks: Light oil on parts subject to atmospheric corrosion.

reassembly: Firing pin complete with its spring back into the bolt, fixed with its pin.
Bolt taken by the top part and squeezed, then inserted in its proper place.
Firearm held vertically; the fore-end guide rods inserted in their respective tracks.
Firearm laid horizontal; the action bars hooked onto the bolt guide, lifting the bars slightly with the other hand.
CHECK the action bars-to-bolt engagement is correct before going further.
Fore-end slid ahead; trigger guard inserted with the hammer COCKED, twisting in at the front locking hole and then seating the rear on the receiver.
Trigger guard pins pushed in — the LONGER pin goes in the forward hole.
If a pistol grip or telescopic stock is fitted: TIGHTEN the retaining nut or ring nut fully, until it solidly contacts the receiver.
Barrel and barrel retaining cap refitted to complete the assembly.
fncheck: With the gun proven empty: check the action bars-to-bolt engagement is correct before the trigger guard goes back, because it cannot be seen afterwards. Refit the trigger guard only with the hammer cocked. On a pistol grip or telescopic stock, confirm the retaining nut is fully tightened against the receiver — a loose stock nut here is a loose trigger group. With everything together, press the safety button until the red ring disappears and confirm it does, work the fore-end fully back and forward to confirm the bolt runs and locks, and check the barrel retaining cap is fully screwed down onto the magazine tube.
